unit: USD per 1,000,000 tokens (standard tier, short context)
notes: Edit this file when prices change. Models not listed here show their token counts but no dollar figure.
cached_input is the rate for input tokens the provider served from its prompt cache; leave it out to bill them at the input rate.
Local providers (lm_studio, unsloth) are always shown as free.
Sources: OpenAI and Google pricing pages, Anthropic API price list, all checked 2026-10-09.
gpt-5.6-sol is a promotional price, listed as available at least through 2026-11-21.
claude-haiku-5-5 is priced higher for prompts over 100K tokens (0.50 in / 2.50 out); eval prompts are far smaller than that.
gemini-3.5-flash is not on Google's pricing page, so it is deliberately left out.
